newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices tread water, players ponder EMU.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices tread water, players ponder EMU.

text.p: Danish bond prices showed a mixed sense of direction on Tuesday as players awaited more clues from Paris after a French call for time to think over the EU stability pact.
"The bond market on Tuesday will again focus on France's EMU statements,"a dealer said.
At 0840 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was slightly up to 111.27, yielding 6.28 percent, from Monday's closing 111.25.
But the seven percent 2007 bond was down to 103.83, yielding 6.47 percent, compared to Monday's 103.92 close.
The 2006 yield gap to the 10-year German bund shrunk one basis point to 50 bp and the 2007-bund differential closed by one point to 68 bp.
The crown firmed slightly to 3.8072 to the mark from Monday's 3.8074.
The 2006 bond's June future rose 0.2 point to 111.26 and the six percent mortgage bond due 2026 gained 0.15 point to 89.65. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969650
